description: Compute Estimated Daily Intake, Target Hazard Quotient per element, Hazard Index and optional cancer risk for contaminants in food. The result echoes the inputs received, lists plausibility warnings and includes the required Labreador citation.

elements.description: Between 1 and 40 contaminants in one food sample. All concentrations must be in mg/kg wet weight; provide every contaminant intended for the Hazard Index because omitted contaminants are not included.

items.description: One contaminant with a matched food concentration, oral reference dose and optional cancer slope factor.

concentrationMgPerKg.description: Measured food concentration in mg/kg wet weight, matching the intake basis. Convert other units and dry-weight concentrations before calling; measured zero is allowed, non-detect text is not.

csf.description: Optional positive oral cancer slope factor in (mg/kg body weight/day)^-1 for this chemical species. Omit if unavailable; omission does not mean zero cancer risk. Uses daily lifetime exposure.

name.description: Contaminant name or chemical species, for example Cd or inorganic As; at most 40 characters.

rfdMgPerKgDay.description: Positive oral reference dose in mg/kg body weight/day for this contaminant and exposure route; supply a verified reference value.

ingestionRateKgPerDay.description: Food ingestion rate in kg/day (wet weight basis). Convert kg/year by dividing by 365.

name: dietary_risk
title: Dietary health risk (EDI, THQ, HI, CR)
